text: The Goa Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1978 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19791 Act Number: 1 Enactment Date: 1979-01-25 Act Year: 1979 Short Title: The Goa Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains Act, 1978 Long Title: An Act to provide for the preservation of ancient monuments and archaeological sites and remains other than those declared by or under any law made by Parliament to be of national importance, for the regulation of archaeological excavations and for the protection of sculptures, carving and other like objects which are antiquities. Department: Department of Archaeology, Government of Goa.
